title: salix aurita var. cinerea
intro: Salix aurita var. cinerea, commonly known as cinerea willow, is a variety of the silver willow plant, belonging to the Salicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of cinerea willow include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of cinerea willow include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
